title: Air-quality stations
description: Hourly air-quality observations from national monitoring networks, aggregated every half hour: per network, every station's position and newest values in a stations file, and its last 24 hours as columns on one line of an NDJSON file beside it, in one set of pollutants and units (particulates in µg/m³, gases in ppb, CO in ppm) whatever the network. The networks are AirNow (US, Canada, Mexico and US missions abroad, about 2 000 monitors) and Hong Kong's Environmental Protection Department (18 stations). The values are preliminary, as the agencies publish them, and no air-quality index is computed. A rolling window with no fixed start — only the newest round is published, and each round carries the whole window.
